mapper.select: SELECT pm00101 AS catKey, pm00102 AS catName, pm00103 AS parentKey FROM dbo.sdpm001 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE pm00101 IS NOT NULL AND pm00101 != '' ORDER BY pm00101

SELECT d.pm01401 AS poId, d.pm01402 AS lineId, o.pm01303 AS poCode, o.pm01302 AS orderDate, (SELECT TOP 1 v.pf00302 FROM dbo.sdpd004 c WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.sdpf003 v WITH (NOLOCK) ON v.pf00301 = c.pd00404 WHERE UPPER(c.pd00401) = UPPER(o.pm01305)) AS vendorName, d.pm01403 AS srcItemId, m.pm00201 AS itemCode, m.pm00202 AS itemName, m.pm00221 AS brand, m.pm00205 AS spec, d.pm01404 AS unitCode, u.pa01302 AS unitName, (SELECT TOP 1 c.pm00102 FROM dbo.sdpm001 c WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE c.pm00101 = m.pm00203) AS itemCategory, d.pm01406 AS qtyOrdered, d.pm01411 AS qtyReceived FROM dbo.sdpm014 d WITH (NOLOCK) -- GUID 大小写不敏感：老库 GUID 大小写不一，UPPER 归一避免 join 不上 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpm013 o WITH (NOLOCK) ON UPPER(o.pm01301) = UPPER(d.pm01401) LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpm002 m WITH (NOLOCK) ON UPPER(m.pm00200) = UPPER(d.pm01403) LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpa013 u WITH (NOLOCK) ON u.pa01301 = d.pm01404 -- 订单日期窗口：兼容 yyyy/MM/dd 与 yyyy-MM-dd（统一成 - 后取前10位比较） WHERE LEFT(REPLACE(o.pm01302, '/', '-'), 10) >= #{beginYm} AND LEFT(REPLACE(o.pm01302, '/', '-'), 10) <= #{endYm}

SELECT m.pm00200 AS srcItemId, m.pm00201 AS itemCode, m.pm00202 AS itemName, m.pm00205 AS spec, m.pm00221 AS brand, m.pm00203 AS categoryKey, (SELECT TOP 1 c.pm00102 FROM dbo.sdpm001 c WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE c.pm00101 = m.pm00203) AS categoryName, (SELECT TOP 1 u.pa01302 FROM dbo.sdpm003 u3 WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.sdpa013 u WITH (NOLOCK) ON u.pa01301 = u3.pm00302 WHERE UPPER(u3.pm00301) = UPPER(m.pm00200) AND u3.pm00303 = 1) AS unitName FROM dbo.sdpm002 m WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE m.pm00201 IN #{code}

SELECT m2.pm02601 AS srcReceiptId, h.pm02702 AS srcLineId, h.pm02712 AS poLineId, m2.pm02603 AS basId, m2.pm02602 AS receiptDate, m2.pm02614 AS [period], m2.pm02623 AS docType, m2.pm02631 AS batchNo, h.pm02725 AS expireDate, h.pm02726 AS storageLocation, h.pm02728 AS [lineNo], h.pm02703 AS srcItemId, m.pm00201 AS itemCode, m.pm00202 AS itemName, m.pm00203 AS catalogNo, m.pm00221 AS brand, m.pm00205 AS spec, (SELECT TOP 1 u.pa01302 FROM dbo.sdpm003 u3 WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.sdpa013 u WITH (NOLOCK) ON u.pa01301 = u3.pm00302 WHERE UPPER(u3.pm00301) = UPPER(h.pm02703) AND u3.pm00303 = 1) AS unitName, (SELECT TOP 1 c.pm00102 FROM dbo.sdpm001 c WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE c.pm00101 = m.pm00203) AS itemCategory, h.pm02706 * h.pm02705 AS qty, h.pm02707 AS priceTaxIn, h.pm02708 AS amountTaxIn, h.pm02709 AS priceExTax, h.pm02710 AS amountExTax, m2.pm02604 AS vendorId, v.pf00302 AS vendorName, m2.pm02605 AS warehouseId, w.pm00402 AS warehouseName, m2.pm02612 AS poId, (SELECT TOP 1 s.pm01303 FROM dbo.sdpm013 s WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE UPPER(s.pm01301) = UPPER(m2.pm02612)) AS poCode, h.pm02723 AS projectId, pj.pa00102 AS projectName, pj.pa00140 AS projectCode, m2.pm02609 AS applicant, o.pj00402 AS applicantName, m2.pm02616 AS auditor, a.pj00402 AS auditorName FROM dbo.sdpm027 h WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.sdpm026 m2 WITH (NOLOCK) ON m2.pm02601 = h.pm02701 -- GUID 大小写不敏感：老库 GUID 大小写不一，UPPER 归一 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpm002 m WITH (NOLOCK) ON UPPER(m.pm00200) = UPPER(h.pm02703) LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpf003 v WITH (NOLOCK) ON UPPER(v.pf00301) = UPPER(m2.pm02604) LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpm004 w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.pm00401 = m2.pm02605 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpa001 pj WITH (NOLOCK) ON UPPER(pj.pa00101) = UPPER(h.pm02723) LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpj004 o WITH (NOLOCK) ON UPPER(o.pj00401) = UPPER(m2.pm02609) LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpj004 a WITH (NOLOCK) ON UPPER(a.pj00401) = UPPER(m2.pm02616) WHERE m2.pm02620 = 0 AND m2.pm02617 = 1 -- TCheck=1 已审核（只同步已审核的入库单） AND m2.pm02623 IN (1, 6) -- 调拨出入(10/11) 不在此列，天然排除 AND m2.pm02614 >= #{beginYm} AND m2.pm02614 <= #{endYm} ORDER BY m2.pm02614, m2.pm02601, h.pm02728

SELECT p.pm02001 AS srcReqId, d.pm02102 AS srcLineId, p.pm02003 AS reqCode, p.pm02002 AS reqDate, p.pm02016 AS [period], d.pm02103 AS srcItemId, m.pm00201 AS itemCode, m.pm00202 AS itemName, d.pm02104 AS qty, d.pm02105 AS price, d.pm02107 AS priceTaxIn, p.pm02004 AS projectId, pj.pa00102 AS projectName, pj.pa00140 AS projectCode, p.pm02008 AS vendorId, v.pf00302 AS vendorName, p.pm02006 AS warehouseId, w.pm00402 AS warehouseName, p.pm02012 AS applicant, o.pj00402 AS applicantName, p.pm02017 AS auditor, a.pj00402 AS auditorName, p.pm02015 AS srcReceiptId, d.pm02108 AS srcLineReceiptId FROM dbo.sdpm021 d WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.sdpm020 p WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.pm02001 = d.pm02101 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpm002 m WITH (NOLOCK) ON m.pm00200 = d.pm02103 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpa001 pj WITH (NOLOCK) ON pj.pa00101 = p.pm02004 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpf003 v WITH (NOLOCK) ON v.pf00301 = p.pm02008 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpm004 w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.pm00401 = p.pm02006 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpj004 o WITH (NOLOCK) ON o.pj00401 = p.pm02012 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpj004 a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.pj00401 = p.pm02017 WHERE p.pm02022 = 0 AND p.pm02019 = 1 AND p.pm02016 >= #{beginYm} AND p.pm02016 <= #{endYm} ORDER BY p.pm02016, p.pm02001, d.pm02102

SELECT p.pm02401 AS srcRetId, d.pm02502 AS srcLineId, p.pm02403 AS retCode, p.pm02402 AS retDate, p.pm02416 AS [period], d.pm02503 AS srcItemId, m.pm00201 AS itemCode, m.pm00202 AS itemName, d.pm02504 AS qty, d.pm02506 AS amount, p.pm02404 AS projectId, pj.pa00102 AS projectName, p.pm02406 AS warehouseId, w.pm00402 AS warehouseName, p.pm02408 AS vendorId, v.pf00302 AS vendorName, p.pm02412 AS applicant, o.pj00402 AS applicantName, p.pm02417 AS auditor, a.pj00402 AS auditorName, d.pm02507 AS srcLineReceiptId FROM dbo.sdpm025 d WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.sdpm024 p WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.pm02401 = d.pm02501 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpm002 m WITH (NOLOCK) ON m.pm00200 = d.pm02503 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpa001 pj WITH (NOLOCK) ON pj.pa00101 = p.pm02404 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpm004 w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.pm00401 = p.pm02406 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpf003 v WITH (NOLOCK) ON v.pf00301 = p.pm02408 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpj004 o WITH (NOLOCK) ON o.pj00401 = p.pm02412 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpj004 a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.pj00401 = p.pm02417 WHERE p.pm02419 = 1 AND p.pm02416 BETWEEN #{beginYm} AND #{endYm} ORDER BY p.pm02416, p.pm02401, d.pm02502

SELECT p.pm02201 AS srcRoId, d.pm02302 AS srcLineId, p.pm02203 AS roCode, p.pm02202 AS roDate, p.pm02214 AS [period], d.pm02303 AS srcItemId, m.pm00201 AS itemCode, m.pm00202 AS itemName, d.pm02304 AS qty, d.pm02305 AS price, p.pm02204 AS vendorId, v.pf00302 AS vendorName, p.pm02205 AS warehouseId, w.pm00402 AS warehouseName, p.pm02212 AS poId, (SELECT TOP 1 s.pm01303 FROM dbo.sdpm013 s WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE s.pm01301 = p.pm02212) AS poCode, p.pm02209 AS applicant, o.pj00402 AS applicantName, p.pm02213 AS auditor, a.pj00402 AS auditorName, d.pm02311 AS srcLineReceiptId FROM dbo.sdpm023 d WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.sdpm022 p WITH (NOLOCK) ON p.pm02201 = d.pm02301 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpm002 m WITH (NOLOCK) ON m.pm00200 = d.pm02303 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpf003 v WITH (NOLOCK) ON v.pf00301 = p.pm02204 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpm004 w WITH (NOLOCK) ON w.pm00401 = p.pm02205 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpj004 o WITH (NOLOCK) ON o.pj00401 = p.pm02209 LEFT JOIN dbo.sdpj004 a WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.pj00401 = p.pm02213 WHERE p.pm02217 = 1 AND p.pm02215 = 1 AND p.pm02214 BETWEEN #{beginYm} AND #{endYm} ORDER BY p.pm02214, p.pm02201, d.pm02302
